This is a mass spectrum (line/intensity plot), an exempt plot type where overlaying individual data points is not applicable.

Bar chart shows the proportion of protein species bound to specific numbers of metal atoms as directly measured from a single native MS spectrum (percentage of peak intensities), not a mean calculated across independent replicates. There is no indication of error bars or replicate data, so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.
Same as panel C: proportions derived from a single native MS measurement per condition, not an average of replicates requiring individual point overlay.

Bar chart shows single chemical shift perturbation (CSP) values per residue at three metal equivalents, a direct NMR measurement rather than a mean across biological/technical replicates, so no individual data points need to be shown.
Same as panel G: single CSP measurements per residue/condition from NMR, not an averaged statistic requiring individual point overlay.
